paragraph: No stage is set. No source found since October 2023 names a population register for Burundi. The only item found is a [national prison population database](<https://rolhr.undp.org/annualreport/2025/africa/burundi.html>), which is a record of prisoners and not of residents. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether a population register is under way or in service. Preparing would need a population register to be built, procured or provided for in a new law.

In May 2026 [ANIP reported more than 13.8 million people in the RNPP](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T4-1-S2-3-Benin-FINAL.pdf>), Benin's population register. In February 2025 its director general said [more than 400,000 digitised death records had been taken into the register](<https://www.gouv.bj/article/2994/inquietudes-autour-fiabilite-liste-electorale-informatisee-benin-anip-reaffirme-credibilite-grace-systeme-mise-jour-continue/>). Since February 2026 [children born in pilot health facilities are entered in it from birth](<https://www.unicef.org/benin/recits/b%C3%A9nin-journ%C3%A9e-de-l%C3%A9tat-civil-et-des-statistiques-de-l%C3%A9tat-civil-2026>), ANIP says. In the last twelve months, in September 2026, [its eServices tool drew statistics from the 2026 register](<https://www.banouto.bj/societe/article/20260918-anip-voici-comment-decouvrir-combien-de-beninois-partagent-votre-nom-prenom-ou-date-de-naissance>), covering about 14 million inhabitants.

[Law 027-2024/ALT of 11 October 2024 provides for a national register of the unique identifier](<https://assembleenationale.bf/loip/117>). In the last twelve months, [on 11 November 2026 Burkina Faso launched mass enrolment of residents into the register](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article150706=>), leFaso.net reports. A pilot had enrolled over 16,000 people, and a first count of those enrolled is due at the end of December 2026. No source found since October 2023 says births or deaths are entered in the register. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

[The National Registration (Amendment) Act 2025, assented on 23 March 2025, provides for a Unified Population Register](<https://www.botswanalaws.com/PDF/StatutesActpdf/2025Actpdf/007.pdf>). The Act comes into force on a date the minister sets by notice, and no notice is on record. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Earlier in March 2025 the minister [did not say how births and deaths would reach the planned register](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/85066>). No source found says the register is in service. Establishing would need a population register, or a national ID register serving as one, to be in service.

[ONECI, under the Interior Ministry, runs the RNPP and assigns the national identification number](<https://www.aip.ci/cote-divoire-aip-le-gouvernement-mise-sur-le-parae-pour-renforcer-la-confiance-dans-les-services-publics-numeriques/>). ONECI's director general puts holders at 11 million. [On 16 September 2025 he said ONECI's civil-status system and national server are linked to the register](<https://digitalmag.ci/id-day-2025-lidentite-est-le-parapluie-de-tout-individu-dg-oneci/>). In the last twelve months, [BCPFS and ONECI signed a convention on 2 April 2026 linking the Registre Social Unique to ONECI's databases](<https://filetsociaux-ci.org/registre-social-unique-des-menages-pauvres-et-vulnerables-rsu-signature-dune-convention-entre-le-bureau-de-coordination-du-programme-filets-sociaux-bcpfs-et-loffice-nation/>). In October 2026 [ONECI was digitising the civil-status registers of births, marriages and deaths to feed the RNPP](<https://digitalmag.ci/digitalisation-trois-outils-de-modernisation-de-letat-civil/>), with about 3.8 million records digitised in 14 centres.

[In August 2024 ONIP's legal expert called the general population file (FGP) the single reference for identifying individuals](<https://acp.cd/genre/enregistrement-a-letat-civil-le-renforcement-de-la-communication-recommande-a-la-rdc-2/>). [ONIP was created in 2011 to build the file, and a 2022 decree organised identification and census operations](<https://www.bbc.com/afrique/articles/cy633p6ezq1o>). [On 4 November 2025 Kinshasa's provincial Interior Minister launched the digitisation of the city's population register](<https://www.radiookapi.net/2025/11/04/actualite/politique/debut-du-projet-de-digitalisation-de-registre-de-la-population-de>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the general population file is in service. Establishing would need a population register, or a national ID register serving as one, to be in service.

No stage is set. No source found since October 2023 names a population register for Cape Verde. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether a population register is under way or in service. No change has been found in the last twelve months, and nothing else has been found. Preparing would need a population register to be built, procured or provided for in a new law.

In July 2026 [La Nation reported that the DGPF searches the population database for each ID applicant](<https://www.lanation.dj/carte-nationale-didentite-biometrique-dans-les-coulisses-de-la-nouvelle-identite-nationale/>). Each file goes into the RNPP platform before biometric enrolment. [Law 39/AN/19 of 21 January 2019 provides for the register and an identification number given at birth](<https://numerique.gouv.dj/Articles/detailArticleAvancee/15>). That report is the only item found in the last twelve months, and it does not say births or deaths enter the register. No source found since October 2023 says they do. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

[The Interior Ministry says the national civil-status register is in use](<https://www.lnr-dz.com/2024/01/18/merad-senquiert-de-letat-davancement-des-projets-de-modernisation/>), with nearly 111 million consultations in 2023. [It entered service on 15 February 2014](<https://dknews-dz.com/article/3758-collectivites-le-ministere-de-linterieur-presente-le-registre-national-de-letat-civil-automatise-mis-en-service-samedi.html>), with about 59 million digitised birth acts from 1,541 communes. [A 2025 study says the national automated civil-status register links every commune and holds birth, marriage and death certificates](<https://imcra-az.org/uploads/public_files/2025-10/81246.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The latest dated fact is that [on 18 May 2025 the Council of Ministers sent back a draft civil-status law](<https://lavoiedalgerie.dz/le-president-tebboune-exige-une-reforme-approfondie-de-letat-civil/2025/20/09/>).

No stage is set. No source found since October 2023 names a population register for Egypt. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether a population register is under way or in service. No change has been found in the last twelve months, and nothing else has been found. Preparing would need a population register to be built, procured or provided for in a new law.

[Decree D/2025/052 of 14 April 2025 sets up the national register of natural persons](<https://guineelex.com/decrets-arretes/decret-d-2025-052-prg-cnrd-sgg>). On 19 July 2025 the ministry [put it at 9,010,181 people after removing duplicates](<https://www.guinee114.com/2025/07/19/matd-les-statistiques-provisoires-du-registre-national-des-personnes-physiques-et-du-fichier-electoral-biometrique-presentees-aux-acteurs-socio-politiques/>). In the last twelve months, on 15 July 2026 ONECI [began digitising civil status archives, which the director said will set up the register](<https://www.africaguinee.com/fichier-electoral-et-etat-civil-bientot-un-numero-identifiant-unique-pour-chaque-citoyen/>). In September the minister [launched work on extending it](<https://www.guinee114.com/2026/09/18/matd-dge-djenabou-toure-lance-latelier-sur-lextension-du-registre-national-des-personnes-physiques/>). No source found says the register is in service. Establishing would need a population register to be in service.

[The Directorate of Population Registration Services runs the Maisha Integrated Population register](<https://web.archive.org/web/20260510014831/https://usajili.go.ke/integrated-population-registration-service>). [Public and private bodies with a signed MOU check identities against the register](<https://web.archive.org/web/20260510014831/https://usajili.go.ke/integrated-population-registration-service>), the State Department for Immigration says. [A Births and Deaths Registration Bill, under validation in March 2026, is to align civil registration with a national population database](<https://citizen.digital/article/govt-moves-to-modernise-civil-registration-as-stakeholders-validate-births-and-deaths-registration-bill-n378534>). In the last twelve months, [Identity Week said in October 2026 that births registered through the e-service pass directly to the population registry](<https://identityweek.net/birth-registration-e-service-reduces-admin-from-months-to-days/>). [Over 270,000 births had been registered that way by September 2026](<https://identityweek.net/birth-registration-e-service-reduces-admin-from-months-to-days/>).

[In October 2026 Liberia's Senate sent President Boakai's proposed US$52 million concession with OeSD International GmbH to committee](<https://liberiapublicradio.com/2026/10/16/liberian-senate-orders-review-of-us52-million-digital-identity-concession-agreement/>). [The concession is for a National Identification Central Digital Civil Registry and Vital Statistics System](<https://liberiapublicradio.com/2026/10/16/liberian-senate-orders-review-of-us52-million-digital-identity-concession-agreement/>), and [it awaits a ratification vote](<https://liberiapublicradio.com/2026/10/16/liberian-senate-orders-review-of-us52-million-digital-identity-concession-agreement/>). That is the only item found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a population register is in service. Establishing would need a population register, or a national ID register serving as one, to be in service.

[The Principal Secretary of Home Affairs said in May 2026 that the ministry alone maintains the National Population Register](<https://www.gov.ls/elections/the-iec-has-launched-its-civic-and-voter-education-strategy-and-voter-registration-programme/>). That statement is the only item found in the last twelve months. [In July 2022 the Health Minister said children registered at birth in hospitals would all be in the National Population Database](<https://www.homeaffairs.gov.ls/lekala-la-tsa-lehae-le-khakola-ngoliso-ea-litlhaho-le-mafu-sepetleleng-sa-st-josephs-roma/>). No source found since October 2023 says births or deaths are entered in the register. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

[The Times of India reports 22 million of 39 million people in the population register](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/technology/times-techies/theyre-taking-dpi-to-the-world/articleshow/131849408.cms>). [The Head of Government's department counted 22.5 million people enrolled by mid-September 2025](<https://maroc.ma/fr/actualites/le-gouvernement-attache-la-mise-en-oeuvre-optimale-du-chantier-de-generalisation-de-la-protection>). [ANSS says households must be in the register to receive direct social aid](<https://www.anss.gov.ma/fr/conditions-d-eligibilite>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says births or deaths are entered in the population register. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

[In April 2024 PRODIGY's answers to bidders on tender DP n°027/028 put the register of persons within lot 8](<https://digital.gov.mg/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Reponses-aux-demandes-de-clarification-20240412-1505.pdf>). Lot 8 is the identity management system tender, and bids were due by 29 April 2024. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a population register is in service. Establishing would need a population register, or a national ID register serving as one, to be in service.

In May 2025 [DNEC said the population's biometric file was built from civil status records under RAVEC](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T2-P1-S2-3-MALI_FINAL.pdf>), and that ANSAEC administers it. On 13 February 2024 [the authorities launched Mali Kura Biométrie to manage the RAVEC data](<https://malikonews.com/mali-mali-kura-biometrie-un-nouveau-systeme-numerique-souverain-des-donnees-ravec/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says births or deaths are entered in the population register. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

[On 29 May 2026 ATDI's World Bank-funded EDGE request for expressions of interest named the National Population Registry](<https://360mozambique.com/tenders/consulting-services-for-the-implementation-of-national-mobile-digital-identity-and-electronic-signature-infrastructure-for-the-republic-of-mozambique/>). It lists the registry as existing infrastructure that a new mobile digital identity must integrate with, and the National Directorate of Civil Identification runs it. That is the only item found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says births or deaths are entered in the population register. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

In June 2026 [the interior minister told the National Assembly the register had passed 5.1 million citizens](<https://kassataya.com/ministre-de-linterieur-lenrolement-de-la-population-est-devenu-un-service-public-permanent-qui-garantit-le-droit-de-tous-les-citoyens-a-lenregistrement/>). It held 3.4 million in 2019. [The government procedures portal, updated on 21 November 2023, sets out how a child born to Mauritanian parents is enrolled in the register](<https://procedures.gov.mr/fr/procedure/1105>). In the last twelve months, [the Budget directorate has set 31 January 2027 as the deadline for retirees to enrol in the register](<https://kassataya.com/mauritanie-quand-la-modernisation-administrative-devient-une-menace-sociale/>). No source found since October 2023 says other systems take records from the register. Mature would need other registers or services to take people's records from the population register.

[A 2024 Pay Research Bureau report says the Civil Status Division monitors the Central Population Database](<https://prb.govmu.org/prb/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/csd.pdf>). The database holds basic information on every person registered in Mauritius and its Outer Islands. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says births or deaths are entered in the database, or that other registers take records from it. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

The home affairs ministry [runs the National Population Registration System](<https://neweralive.na/n44m-paid-to-ghost-grant-beneficiaries/>). In July 2024 the deputy minister said [births and deaths at 135 connected health facilities are notified electronically to the register](<https://thebrief.com.na/2024/07/over-94000-namibians-issued-with-identity-documents/>). The Chief Registrar has said [Covid-19 emergency grant applicants were verified against the register](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-namibia.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026, the Auditor General [checked 488,753 social grant beneficiaries against the population register and found 8,099 with no match](<https://neweralive.na/n44m-paid-to-ghost-grant-beneficiaries/>).

On 3 September 2026 [the director general of territorial administration said the reforms include a National Population Register](<https://anp.ne/diffa-lancement-de-la-tournee-nationale-de-sensibilisation-sur-la-modernisation-de-letat-civil-et-lidentification/>). It is to be a single interoperable referential, with a unique number for each person. [The Interior Ministry says a first enrolment phase begins in Niamey's five districts](<https://www.lesahel.org/tillaberi-reformes-de-letat-civil-et-de-lidentification-une-mission-de-sensibilisation-sillonne-la-region/>), and other regions follow in 2027. That is the first position found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a register is in service. Establishing would need a population register, or a national ID register serving as one, to be in service.

The local government ministry says [the new civil registration system is linked to the National Population Registry](<https://www.minaloc.gov.rw/news-detail/rwanda-launches-new-integrated-civil-registration-system>). An identification agency presentation covering 2016 to 2024 says [the digital civil registration system is integrated with the population register](<https://crvs.unescap.org/system/files/sites/default/files/B1_Session%203.3_75_Bugingo_PPT.pdf>). In the last twelve months, a May 2026 national ID deck [names the National Population Register among existing systems](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-1-Rwanda-FINAL.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says births or deaths are entered in the population register. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

In January 2024 [Biometric Update reported that the 11-digit NIN on the national ID card is a unique number](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202401/sierra-leone-urges-citizens-to-obtain-biometric-id-cards-for-security-services>), linked to each holder's personal details in the national population registry. Citizens were being urged to obtain the biometric card. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says births or deaths are entered in the population register. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

[In October 2025 Eswatini's Home Affairs ministry said its mopping exercise had improved the National Population Register](<https://swazidailynews.com/4842/future/mopping-exercise-brings-government-closer-to-the-people/>). [Home Affairs registered births and deaths in Manzini and Hhohho in the second quarter of 2025/26](<https://swazidailynews.com/4842/future/mopping-exercise-brings-government-closer-to-the-people/>). [In November 2025 the Times of Eswatini reported that an audit of the National Population Registry traced irregular birth certificates and documents to specific typist and registrar user logins](<https://times.co.sz/28643/news/2-home-affairs-employees-fired-over-id-fraud/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Mature would need other registers or services to take people's records from the population register.

[A March 2025 tender for a new Land Valuation System says it is to link to the existing National Population Database](<https://www.ntb.sc/2-stage-tender/consultancy-2-stage/dict-development-of-the-land-valuation-system-lvs>). [The Civil Status Division keeps the database](<https://www.ics.gov.sc/about/department/civil-status-division>), within the Department of Immigration and Civil Status. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says births or deaths are entered in the database. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

[In March 2026 ANATS's director-general said the government has deployed an integrated population and secure-titles system](<https://atpe.td/donnees-securisees-le-ministere-des-finances-dispose-dun-cadre-securise/>), based on the national biometric population register. [In March 2026 the Ministry of Finance and ANATS signed a protocol to consult the biometric population register](<https://atpe.td/donnees-securisees-le-ministere-des-finances-dispose-dun-cadre-securise/>). In the last twelve months, in July 2026, ANATS launched a campaign to register a million children's births. [Its director general said the births collected will be entered in the national biometric register](<https://atpe.td/un-enfant-un-acte-de-naissance-une-operation-pour-enregistrer-un-million-denfants/>). No source found says they have been entered. Operating would need births or deaths registered to be entered in the population register.

[On 16 July 2025 the INS and the Interior Ministry held a workshop on a unified population register](<https://tunisia.unfpa.org/fr/news/r%C3%A9vision-de-la-l%C3%A9gislation-et-de-la-r%C3%A9glementation-de-l%C3%A9tat-civil-et-des-statistiques-pour-la>). It prepared the legal reform. In the last twelve months, in May 2026, [a playbook described the citizen identifier register](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-2-Tunisia-FINAL.pdf>), held under the ministry for local affairs. [The playbook shows the register built and updated from the Madania civil-status database by API](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-2-Tunisia-FINAL.pdf>). [It calls the register the pivot for sectoral identifiers](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-2-Tunisia-FINAL.pdf>). Its data pass to state bodies through the national interoperability platform.

[In a live demonstration, Minister Schreiber showed a digital identity credential issued through the population register](<https://techcentral.co.za/south-africa-digital-id-schreiber-demo/286764/>). [He told Parliament that 377,060 identity numbers remain blocked on the National Population Register](<https://iol.co.za/news/politics/2026-07-17-home-affairs-struggles-to-unblock-identity-numbers-due-to-unserviceable-addresses/>), which Home Affairs runs. [Home Affairs says the existing register records names, births and deaths](<https://www.sanews.gov.za/south-africa/schreiber-welcomes-approval-revised-white-paper-citizenship>). In the last twelve months, [President Ramaphosa said government is building an Intelligent Population Register with biometric data for everyone in the country](<https://www.sanews.gov.za/south-africa/sa-unveils-biometric-population-register-tighten-migration-controls>), to be the base for a digital ID. [Banks, mobile operators and insurers check customers in real time against the register](<https://weetracker.com/2026/01/27/south-africa-id-verification-fee-court-case/>).

[The Zimbabwe Population Registration System is a central database of citizens' demographic information](<https://www.heraldonline.co.zw/zims-digital-population-registry-sets-benchmark-for-africa/>), the minister told registrars in July 2026. In the last twelve months, in February 2026, the minister said [the system updates automatically and in real time when a death is registered](<https://www.heraldonline.co.zw/registrar-general-to-get-voters-roll-custody/>). [The system is integrated with the Department of Immigration's Online Border Management System](<https://www.heraldonline.co.zw/zims-digital-population-registry-sets-benchmark-for-africa/>), which is fully operational, The Herald reports. A link to the police is under way, the minister said.
